source.name: FAA Aircraft Characteristics Database
source.note: The database publishes weight limits and an airport-planning approach speed. It does not publish takeoff or landing distance, ground roll, or V1/VR/V2; those axes are marked unsupported rather than estimated.

operatingRange.basis: Stratos input window, not an aircraft operating limitation.

takeoff.reason: No licensed takeoff distance, ground roll or V1/VR/V2 table is available for this type. The FAA ACD publishes weights and approach speed only.

landing.reason: No licensed landing distance table is available for this type. The FAA ACD publishes weights and approach speed only.
landing.vrefBasis: FAA ACD approach speed at maximum landing weight; an airport-planning value, not an AFM VREF.

corrections.reason: The FAA ACD publishes weight limits and an approach speed only; it contains no takeoff or landing corrections for wind, slope, surface, flaps, thrust, anti-ice or braking.
